comment: Written against MiniMax Code (mcode) 0.5.9 and checked unchanged against 0.6.3, from live sessions recorded in a pty; must be re-verified when MCode changes its TUI. The tool approval dialog ('◆ Approval required' box with 'Run this command?', the numbered '1 Allow for this conversation' options and the '↑/↓ choose · Enter confirm · Esc deny' footer) and its 'Deny this action?' follow-up are BLOCKED; the Braille spinner line ending in '· Esc stop' ('⠋ Loading 2s · … · Esc stop', '⠋ Running 5s · …') is WORKING; the '›  Ask Mcode to do anything' composer with its 'Enter send' / '@ file or Plugin' hint line is IDLE. The composer stays visible while MCode works, so the idle rule vetoes on 'Esc stop' and has the lowest priority; the approval rule vetoes on it too and anchors its patterns to the dialog box border, because a transcript that quotes the dialog text must not read as a pending approval. No rule depends on the alternate-screen flag (the default TUI mode does not switch screens).
